provenance.derivation_note: In-phantom beam-quality scalars for the FiR 1 K63 epithermal beam at the 14 cm aperture, 250 kW, in the cubical water reference phantom (~51x51x47 cm). Absolute depth-profile tables are figure-only in the accessible literature, so this record encodes the tabulated scalar figures of merit (advantage depth, advantage ratio, peak therapeutic ratio) plus the documented thermal-maximum depth as a documentation-only entry. All uncertainties are null where the source does not state them; Mn-55/Au-197 foil activation uncertainty is approximately +/-3% per Koivunoro 2014, and calculated-to-measured phantom agreement is reported at 3-5%. The published advantage figures assume clinical boron uptake (tumor:normal ~3.5) folded into the dose weighting; the computed side uses the documented CBE-weight convention, which the comparison note must carry.
